column6: @wDN{Ninlil}, comprehensively replete with numerous divine powers! Equal to the Great Mountain; deciding destinies with Lord @wDN{Nunamnir}; suited to the Great Lion; pre-eminent over heaven and earth! Joyous princess, lady with the princely divine powers; conveying terror; wise with advice! Mother @wDN{Ninlil}, whose speech is a storm, you are a pleasure to @wDN{Enlil's} heart -- he has embraced you! Overseeing everything, Lord @wDN{Nunamnir} loves you. You occupy a holy dais, Mother @wDN{Ninlil}; you provide the …… of prosperity. All the great lords and sovereigns have paid homage to you. Riding in princely style under a broad shelter in coolness, Mother @wDN{Ninlil}, you are the goddess who provides the divine powers of joy and prosperity.
@wDN{Ninlil}, you are more majestic than the other great gods, you are elevated with great and terrifying divine powers.

…… equal to the great gods, @gap{1 line fragmentary} @gap{approx. 6 lines missing} @gap{1 line fragmentary} Mother @wDN{Ninlil}, righteous woman of @wDN{Enlil}, you dwell in the @wTN{Ki-ur}. In his heart filled with pleasure at your joyous divine powers, he has embraced you. The @wDN{Enki} and @wDN{Ninki} deities have perfected their divine powers throughout all countries for you. My lady, your speech is majestic -- take pleasure in your @wTN{E-kur}!
Good woman, Mother @wDN{Ninlil}, you ride across heaven and earth.

My lady, unique and outstanding goddess throughout heaven and earth! Mother @wDN{Ninlil}, majestic lady, unique and outstanding goddess throughout heaven and earth! In his heart filled with pleasure at your joyous divine powers you are his beloved, …… into the future.
An @fsux{adab} of @wDN{Ninlil}. @notep{lines 33 and 34 are written as one line in source}
